name: Rio Doreze
source:
He is the younger of the twins of the Dreze family.

He has black hair and eyes, inherited from his mother. He is a beautiful boy and sharp witted boy.

He has a complex about his slender limbs and being shorter than his older sister. As a reaction to this, he has a strong desire for old-fashioned masculinity.
